source.path: Wolfe et al. /Wolfe et al experimental data.csv

outcome.specialists: Didinium nasutum OR Dileptus anser terminal-day density > 0
outcome.primary: generalist AND >=1 specialist present anywhere in same metacommunity at day 21
outcome.interpretation: joint metacommunity guild retention, not same-patch co-occurrence or persistence over time

contrast.primary: equal-weight mean across 18 patch-count 4/6 × matrix 3 × corridor 3 treatment strata of (heterogeneous joint observed proportion minus homogeneous joint observed proportion)
contrast.observed_only_point: proportion by observed units (3 or 4) per arm
contrast.worst_case_missing_bound: replace all missing binary joint outcomes with 0 or 1 in each arm adversarially, keeping original planned denominator 4 in all cells; average 18 strata bounds
contrast.lower_bound_formula: mean over strata [heterogeneous observed successes /4 - (homogeneous successes + homogeneous missing count)/4]
contrast.upper_bound_formula: mean over strata [(heterogeneous successes + heterogeneous missing count)/4 - homogeneous successes/4]
contrast.within_arm_bootstrap: 10,000 independent-within-factorial-cell replicates for each observed group size; descriptive percentile 95% interval
contrast.uncertainty_caveat: bootstrap excludes missing-outcome uncertainty; bounded interval separately contains worst-case attrition scenarios
secondary: joint contrast by patch count 4 and 6 (no inferential upgrade)
